description.zh-CN: 开源桌面 AI 助手兼 MCP 客户端：聊天、知识库、本地嵌入、18 家模型供应商，界面支持中英双语，数据全部留在本机。
description.en: Open-source desktop AI assistant and MCP client: chat, knowledge base, local embeddings and 18 model providers, with a bilingual UI and everything stored on your machine.

node.recommended: not required (Electron bundle ships its own runtime)
node.supported: not required (Electron bundle ships its own runtime)

runtime.note: Electron desktop build via electron-builder (productName 5ire, appId app.5ire.desktop). macOS builds are separate x64 / arm64 packages; the Windows build is an NSIS installer that installs machine-wide (upstream config: oneClick false, perMachine true) and therefore needs administrator rights.

packages.name: 5ire Desktop (NSIS, win32-x64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-19, upstream published sha256; verified by direct download)

channels.note: Official electron-builder NSIS installer (machine-wide install — upstream sets perMachine true, so an administrator prompt appears)

install.notes: electron-builder NSIS with oneClick false / perMachine true → installs to C:\Program Files\5ire and asks for administrator rights. Silent deploy needs /S plus /allusers (verified on a real Windows machine 2026-11-19: exit code 0, C:\Program Files\5ire\5ire.exe present, app starts).

packages.name: 5ire Desktop (dmg, x64)
packages.hashSource: GitHub release asset digest (2026-11-19, upstream published sha256)

channels.note: Official electron-builder dmg (contains 5ire.app) — Intel Mac build

args: set -e; M=$(mktemp -d); hdiutil attach -nobrowse -mountpoint "$M" "$HOME/.aibox/cache/downloads/1902a51453d54ee49f7d63a9ff4c3b9bc7d270113b63cbc29c3ce0f2fba6cf55.dmg"; cp -R "$M"/*.app /Applications/; hdiutil detach "$M"; rmdir "$M"
install.notes: electron-builder dmg ships 5ire.app (productName from upstream build config); copy into /Applications. TODO real-machine verification (Phase 3).

upgrade.notes: Run the new release installer over the existing machine-wide install (an administrator prompt appears); conversations, knowledge base and settings survive.

steps: Run the 5ire uninstaller (Start menu) or remove C:\Program Files\5ire
Delete user data folder (see data paths)
uninstall.notes: Provider keys, conversations and the local knowledge base live in the data folder — back up first.

risk.onUninstall: 模型 key、会话与本地知识库都在数据目录，删除即丢失，建议先备份
